title: April Showers Bring May Flowers' Roku Sakura Launches New Manga on June 4
content: The June issue of Kadokawa 's Young Ace magazine revealed last Saturday that Roku Sakura will launch a new romantic comedy manga titled Osananajimi o Shiawase ni Suru Made Shinenai!! (I Won't Die Until I've Made My Childhood Friend Happy!!) in the magazine's next issue on June 4.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Confirms Sudden Dub Delay for Their Coolest Spring 2026 Anime
content: One of Crunchyroll ‘s coolest Spring 2026 anime releases has been hit with a sudden delay for the English dub, but the streaming service has confirmed the new release date for its next planned episode.
author: ComicBook

title: Ultraman: Along Came a Spider-Man Manga Ends in 5th Volume
content: Artist Tomo Hirokawa announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Thursday that their Ultraman: Along Came a Spider-Man manga with writer Shigenobu Matsumoto will end in the fifth compiled book volume. The next chapter will be the start of the final volume.
author: ANN

title: Unbelievable Berserk Crossover Resurfaces, Leaving Fans Scratching Their Heads
content: While Berserk has been a landmark within the anime industry for decades, we haven’t had much opportunity to see the Black Swordsman and the Band of the Hawk enter new universes.

title: Tokyopop Launches New Tokyopop Kids Imprint
content: Tokyopop announced on Tuesday that it is launching a children's publishing imprint Tokyopop Kids. The imprint will publish its first titles in fall 2026. The label will focus on publishing manga, graphic novels, picture books, chapter books, middle-grade novels, and Spanish-language titles, for children 12 and under.
author: ANN

title: Major Shonen Jump Anime Reveals Season 3 Release Date Ahead of July Premiere
content: One major anime from Shueisha’s various Jump magazines is coming back for new episodes later this Summer, and the series has finally set a release date for Season 3 of the anime.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Confirms Attack on Titan Theatrical Run for Exclusive Finale Event
content: Based on the acclaimed Shonen manga by Hajime Isayama, the anime adaptation of Attack on Titan reached unprecedented heights of popularity after its debut in 2013. The series was initially adapted by the renowned WIT Studio and released the first three seasons of the anime.
author: ComicBook

title: Star Wars Visions: Tsukumo Manga Debuts at San Diego Comic-Con in July
content: Creator duo Eiichi Shimizu and Tomohiro Shimoguchi announced on their joint X (formerly Twitter ) account on Monday that their Star Wars Visions: Tsukumo manga will launch at San Diego Comic-Con in July. The Japanese version's release will be announced at a later date.
author: ANN

title: Anime Fans Are Heartbroken One of The Biggest Series Isn’t Streaming Anywhere
content: In this age of streaming, old and new anime series alike have found numerous homes. Streaming services such as Crunchyroll , Netflix, HIDIVE, Hulu, and HBO Max are just a few examples of platforms for the ever-growing medium.
